name: House of Cards
description: Betrayed by the White House, Congressman Frank Underwood embarks on a ruthless rise to power. Blackmail, seduction and ambition are his weapons.

videos.title: The Direct Address
videos.overview: Addressing the viewer directly is an important element in House of Cards. In this video, the protagonists tell more background information about the use of direct addressing in House of Cards.

videos.title: Backstage Politics on the set of House of Cards
videos.overview: A look behind of House of Cards.

videos.title: A Death In New Mexico
videos.overview: House of Cards was mainly filmed in the Baltimore's film studios. The location was only relocated to New Mexico once. This video shows which special challenges of the location had to be overcome.

videos.title: Table Read of Episodes 12 & 13
videos.overview: This video shows how the producer, the director, the actors and other guys prepare for the shooting of episodes 12 & 13 of House of Cards in a joint lecture.

videos.title: Two Houses
videos.overview: In this video, the makers of the US version of House of Cards tell how they followed the British model and where and why they deviated from the model.

videos.title: Line of Succession
videos.overview: A glimpse into the creating process of each episode

videos.title: Politics for the sake of politics
videos.overview: Politics is only the back drop, the themes are universal. What is the show about? It’s about relationships and power, not just politics.

videos.title: Chapter 1
videos.overview: When the newly elected President reneges on a promise, Frank and Claire decide to sever all allegiances and toss the rules out the window.

videos.title: Chapter 2
videos.overview: Frank uses a young reporter, Zoe Barnes, to spin a story that puts the White House on its heels. Claire makes a cold-blooded move at work.

videos.title: Chapter 3
videos.overview: Frank must leave union negotiations to deal with a crisis in his home district. Zoe negotiates the politics of being a journalist on the rise.

videos.title: Chapter 4
videos.overview: Frank shakes down the Congressional leadership. Peter Russo must choose between politics and family.

videos.title: Chapter 5
videos.overview: Frank's fight over the Education Bill threatens Claire's own ambitions. Zoe mixes work and play.

videos.title: Chapter 6
videos.overview: Frank strikes back at the striking teachers. Claire is caught off guard by a deathbed confession.

videos.title: Chapter 7
videos.overview: Frank wins a major battle, but doesn't pause to rest on his laurels. Peter must face his past. Stamper hushes a secret.

videos.title: Chapter 8
videos.overview: Frank is honored at his alma mater, while Peter returns to Philly. Both men tackle unfinished business.

videos.title: Chapter 9
videos.overview: Russo hits the road with V.P. Matthews. Frank and Stamper try to whip up support in Congress. Claire looks out for herself.

videos.title: Chapter 10
videos.overview: Rebellion on all fronts. Claire defies Frank, Zoe finds comfort in someone new, and Peter makes an ultimatum.

videos.title: Chapter 11
videos.overview: Claire fuels an old flame. Peter wrestles with his demons. Frank crosses the point of no return.

videos.title: Chapter 12
videos.overview: Frank must make an unforeseen detour. Zoe, Lucas and Janine get closer to the truth.

videos.title: Chapter 13
videos.overview: Frank scrambles to keep his plan on track. Claire is haunted by choices old and new. Zoe poses a serious threat.

videos.title: Chapter 14
videos.overview: The Underwoods tackle two threats that could bring their plans to ruin. Frank grooms his replacement as Whip. Claire goes on the offensive.

videos.title: Chapter 15
videos.overview: Frank puts China in the cross-hairs. Claire confronts a painful trauma from her past. Lucas Goodwin presses for the truth.

videos.title: Chapter 16
videos.overview: Tension rises between Frank and Raymond Tusk as the situation with China deteriorates. A battle in the Senate pits Frank against the Republicans.

videos.title: Chapter 17
videos.overview: A terror scare at the Capitol traps Frank with a resentful Donald Blythe. Claire gives a live interview that rocks the media.

videos.title: Chapter 18
videos.overview: Frank back-channels with a Chinese billionaire. Lucas uses extreme measures to expose the Vice President. A shadowy figure joins Team Underwood.

videos.title: Chapter 19
videos.overview: Amidst an energy crisis, Frank and Tusk end their shaky alliance. Lucas must make a difficult choice. Stamper grows closer to Rachel.

videos.title: Chapter 20
videos.overview: Despite some friction, the Walkers deepen their friendship with the Underwoods. But it's all-out war between Frank and Tusk.

videos.title: Chapter 21
videos.overview: The war with Tusk intensifies. Claire influences Tricia Walker politically and domestically. Frank has a show-down with Linda Vasquez.

videos.title: Chapter 22
videos.overview: Things get personal when Tusk blindsides the Underwoods with a scandal. Freddy and his BBQ joint get caught up in the mix.

videos.title: Chapter 23
videos.overview: With a military stand-off overseas and potential violence at home, Frank wants to finish off Tusk for good. Claire and Jackie Sharp collide.

videos.title: Chapter 24
videos.overview: A Special Prosecutor interrogates Frank. Remy Danton tries to keep his options open. Stamper wrestles with his demons.

videos.title: Chapter 25
videos.overview: Frank finds himself shut out, and Claire makes a difficult sacrifice. Stamper tries to regain control.

videos.title: Chapter 26
videos.overview: Frank faces annihilation while the nation is in an uproar. Stamper must tie up loose ends. Claire feels the cost of ruthlessness.

videos.title: Chapter 27
videos.overview: A rocky start for the Underwood Presidency. Frank wants to introduce an ambitious jobs program, while Claire sets her sights on the United Nations.

videos.title: Chapter 28
videos.overview: Claire's U.N. bid runs into trouble. Frank fights off mutiny with a bold address to the country.

videos.title: Chapter 29
videos.overview: The Russian president's state visit becomes a cold war of wills, and some punks heat things up.

videos.title: Chapter 30
videos.overview: Claire bypasses Russia at the U.N. Frank tries to outmaneuver a potential challenger and ends up face to face with a higher power.

videos.title: Chapter 31
videos.overview: Frank declares war on Congress to jump-start his jobs program. Claire spars with the Russian Ambassador.

videos.title: Chapter 32
videos.overview: Frank and Claire travel to Moscow to negotiate the return of an imprisoned U.S. citizen. Claire takes a stand that jeopardizes their plans.

videos.title: Chapter 33
videos.overview: The damage is done and the Underwoods must repair it. But deep wounds don't heal fast, and sometimes not at all.

videos.title: Chapter 34
videos.overview: A hurricane endangers more than just the entire East Coast and Frank must make a difficult choice.

videos.title: Chapter 35
videos.overview: The Jordan Valley erupts in chaos as Frank's campaign is picking up steam. Claire gets distrubing intel and counsels him.

videos.title: Chapter 36
videos.overview: Frank needs to deal with Petrov one on one while Claire tries to preserve the peace-keeping mission. Sacrifices must be made.

videos.title: Chapter 37
videos.overview: Things turn ugly when Frank, Jackie, and Heather square off during their first debate. Tom joins Claire on the campaign trail.

videos.title: Chapter 38
videos.overview: Heather Dunbar goes for the jugular, forcing Claire to confront her worst fears. The rift between Frank and Claire widens.

videos.title: Chapter 39
videos.overview: In the midst of the Iowa caucuses, Frank and Claire must confront hard truths about each other.

videos.title: Chapter 40
videos.overview: Claire's absence causes problems for Frank on the campaign trail amid rumors of a marital rift. Claire tries to strike out on her own.

videos.title: Chapter 41
videos.overview: As Claire begins exploring a campaign of her own, she and Frank engage in backdoor political maneuvering. But this time they're not on the same side.

videos.title: Chapter 42
videos.overview: Claire joins Frank as he stumps in South Carolina, but he doesn't trust her. A disastrous scandal blindsides Frank's campaign on primary day.

videos.title: Chapter 43
videos.overview: Claire threatens Frank. Frank makes a politically bold move that may provoke Russia. An event at a campaign stop changes everything.

videos.title: Chapter 44
videos.overview: Claire advises Donald Blythe on dealing with Petrov. Further investigation of Lucas Goodwin dredges up his accusations against Frank.

videos.title: Chapter 45
videos.overview: Claire clashes with the Secretary of State over her involvement in negotiations with Russia. Dunbar must choose between her campaign and her ethics.

videos.title: Chapter 46
videos.overview: Frank and Claire adjust to their new reality. The search for Frank's running mate begins. Frank starts a campaign to weaken Conway's strong support.

videos.title: Chapter 47
videos.overview: Formidable as ever, both Underwoods have their eyes on the big picture as they manipulate a potential running mate and push the gun bill.

videos.title: Chapter 48
videos.overview: At the convention, Frank and his team publicly push for Catherine Durant to be chosen as his running mate, but privately pursue a different agenda.

videos.title: Chapter 49
videos.overview: As Frank deals with a new threat to his candidacy, Claire has doubts about their plan. Claire faces a difficult decision concerning her mother.

videos.title: Chapter 50
videos.overview: Frank ups the ante on the war on terror to counter Conway's public show of strength. Tom joins Claire on the campaign trail.

videos.title: Chapter 51
videos.overview: Frank asks Will to help deal with extremists threatening to murder hostages. Hammerschmidt digs deeper into the allegations against Frank.

videos.title: Chapter 52
videos.overview: As the hostage situation continues, Claire secretly negotiates with Yusuf al Ahmadi. Frank confronts Hammerschmidt.

videos.title: Chapter 53
videos.overview: As Congress debates investigating Frank, he and Claire attempt to stoke fear of terrorism. Tom Yates continues his stay in the White House.

videos.title: Chapter 54
videos.overview: Frank and his team work to leverage support in key states by any means necessary. Claire learns some upsetting news about one of Frank's friends.

videos.title: Chapter 55
videos.overview: The day before the election, Conway holds a 24-hour Skype session with voters, while Frank and Claire stump in key states and try to discredit him.

videos.title: Chapter 56
videos.overview: With a tight race and low voter turnout on Election Day, things look grim for Frank. But he's still got one more trick up his sleeve.

videos.title: Chapter 57
videos.overview: Nine weeks after Election Day, the Underwoods work to consolidate their power. Leann tries to track down a missing Aidan Macallan.

videos.title: Chapter 58
videos.overview: In the midst of uncertainty, suspected Russian forces take over an American station in Antarctica. Meanwhile, a damaging news leak could hurt Frank.

videos.title: Chapter 59
videos.overview: When a crisis forces White House personnel to take shelter in a bunker, Commerce Department official Jane Davis negotiates through back channels.

videos.title: Chapter 60
videos.overview: While Frank attends an elite men's weekend gathering to firm up support, Claire deals with a stranded Russian ship and threats from Petrov.

videos.title: Chapter 61
videos.overview: Petrov tries to influence affairs in the U.S. Jane discusses her agenda with Claire. With her job at stake, Leann reaches out to a reporter for help.

videos.title: Chapter 62
videos.overview: The Underwoods and their team angle to undermine the revived committee investigating Frank. Hammerschmidt's investigation heats up.

videos.title: Chapter 63
videos.overview: As the team tries to control fallout from damaging testimony and leaks, everyone is under suspicion and tensions flare between Frank and Claire.

videos.title: Chapter 64
videos.overview: Frank attempts to stop Cathy from testifying. With Hammerschmidt sniffing out the truth, the Underwoods throw someone close to them under the bus.

videos.title: Chapter 65
videos.overview: In the wake of a surprising announcement, everything at the White House is shaken up. A decision must be made about whether to go to war.

videos.title: Chapter 66
videos.overview: As the first woman president, Claire faces increased scrutiny and threats. Sibling power couple Annette and Bill Shepherd attempt to influence policy.

videos.title: Chapter 67
videos.overview: Claire clashes with the Shepherds and Mark Usher, who pressure her to sign the Future Act. Doug makes an unexpected move.

videos.title: Chapter 68
videos.overview: The Shepherds push Claire on a Supreme Court nomination. Doug works to find a new path for himself. Claire consults with Jane on Syria.

videos.title: Chapter 69
videos.overview: As a crisis mounts in Syria, Russian President Viktor Petrov wants to make a deal with Claire. Questions arise about Tom Yates's whereabouts.

videos.title: Chapter 70
videos.overview: Claire allows her enemies to think she's incapacitated as they plot to remove her from office. Doug's investigation leads him to uncover a secret.

videos.title: Chapter 71
videos.overview: Claire makes staff changes. The Shepherds try to recruit Doug to their side. With Mark facing intense scrutiny, Jane offers advice.

videos.title: Chapter 72
videos.overview: While the Shepherd family attempts to diminish Claire's power, Doug goes off the grid but continues angling to advance his agenda.

videos.title: Chapter 73
videos.overview: Claire tries to tarnish Frank's legacy. Doug provokes Claire by releasing excerpts from Frank's diary. A rift develops between the Shepherds.

awards: Won 7 Primetime Emmys. 35 wins & 220 nominations total
